description: This file defines functions and configuration for setting up and managing IPv6-in-IPv4 tunnels (6in4) in OpenWrt, including IP address validation, tunnel setup, and update routines.

methods.name: test_6in4_rfc1918
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address belongs to private or special ranges (RFC 1918, RFC 6598).

methods.name: proto_6in4_update
methods.description: Executes a command with a timeout, used for updating tunnel status.

methods.name: proto_6in4_add_prefix
methods.description: Adds an IPv6 prefix to the configuration.

methods.name: proto_6in4_setup
methods.description: Sets up the IPv6-in-IPv4 tunnel with provided configuration parameters.

methods.name: proto_6in4_init_config
methods.description: Initializes default configuration options for the protocol.
